execution_contract.optimizer: actual input/target unchanged; legacy global PFA RNG consumption allowed
execution_contract.rng: replay restores the first call's post-state; no retry on discrepancy
execution_contract.historical_difference: deterministic algorithms/cuDNN and CUBLAS workspace now enforced; FP32 parameter dtype and historical TF32 flags retained; historical trajectories are not claimed bitwise identical
